thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate and sustained 95th-percentile latency on /v1/embeddings across us-west-2. Error rate 4.6% (baseline 0.3%). Triggered paging to oncall.
maria (oncall): ack, I'm on it. which customer segments are affected?
aj: I'm seeing spikes from a set of clients hitting embeddings-heavy batch jobs — lots of 413/429 and some 504s. Throughput spiked ~3x for embeddings, chat steady.
kevin: looks like a sudden retry storm from our internal batch worker. Request pattern: huge parallel requests for long-context embeddings.
maria (oncall): ok plan — short-term live mitigations: 1) tighten per-route quotas for embeddings to reduce overall tail load 2) temporarily deprioritize embeddings on shared pools 3) disable rerank endpoint for free-tier to free up capacity 4) inform support + throttle customers doing retries. Any objections?
sam (support): please tag which customers will get quota changes so we can draft messages. Also will this affect paid customers on Dedicated?
lirong: Dedicated customers unaffected by hosted quota changes. For hosted free/standard tiers we can apply route-specific limits.
sre-bot: Suggested quick quota tweaks (via admin API):
```
POST /internal/admin/quotas/patch
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "tier": "standard",
  "max_rps": 8,
  "burst": 16
}
```
This will cap sustained request rate.
kevin: +1 to that. Also add a short per-req token cap for embeddings to reduce long-context jobs:
```
PATCH /internal/admin/limits
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "max_input_tokens": 4096
}
```
That prevents token-hungry jobs from stomping the pool.
maria (oncall): I'm going to apply the standard-tier embeddings cap now and set rerank disabled for free tier. I'll post the exact admin audit IDs.
deploy-bot: deploy requested by maria to apply quota patch to prod-config - deploy queued.
maria (oncall): applied quota change id=audit_2026_312777_01. rerank disabled for free-tier id=audit_2026_312777_02. Observing...
aj: after the cap, 95th latency for embeddings dropped ~40% and error rate down to 1.2%. Good improvement.
sam (support): Notifying top-10 affected tenants (internal list) and adding mitigation steps: reduce parallelism, backoff, and staggered retries. Drafted message for review: "We're applying temporary rate limits on embeddings to stabilize latency. Paid Dedicated customers unaffected. If you're impacted, contact support."
lirong: Recommend also adding route-level pref scaling: route.priority = Low for embeddings standard-tier so chat gets first dibs on GPU slots.
kevin: Note: rerank saw low traffic but each call is heavy. Disabling free-tier rerank freed ~6% capacity. Consider a longer-term quota profile for rerank.
maria (oncall): Handing off to aj for follow-up monitoring and postmortem. aj, you'll own the incident write-up and follow-up actions: adaptive quotas, longer-term token caps, and a retry-safety header enforcement.
aj: got it. I'll keep monitoring for 2h, then schedule postmortem. Initial blameless notes: retry storms + long-context embeddings + insufficient per-route shaping.
sre-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev2. Recording mitigation steps and audit IDs: [audit_2026_312777_01, audit_2026_312777_02].
maria (oncall): Thanks team. Final quick checklist: support notify sent (sam), quotas reverted in 3h if stable, add eval to Redwood Optimize to detect token-heavy spike patterns.
sam (support): support message sent to affected customers. Slack thread will be linked in the customer ticket.
aj: last check at +25m shows stable baseline. I'll open a follow-up RFC for per-route adaptive throttling and a new metric to detect client-side retry storms.
maria (oncall): handing off fully. closing on-call shift in 10m. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at ts=3127778900.
